title: dress up timothée: drag his fits, and a ticker at the foot
note: Pale pink page, Timothée Chalamet in bright blue bold title type with a small instruction under it (drag and drop to play around with some of his best fits). His cut-out photo in the middle, clothes from red carpets scattered round to drag onto him. Along the bottom a thin electric-blue strip runs one line of small white type, made by @kris10cabrera with a cherry between each repeat. Worth reusing: a ticker that just quietly says who made it or what is on, in one saturated colour against a soft page. Built into the ticker-strip block.
